name: Conduity Capital Plc
summary: Conduity Capital Plc provides products and services based on Feng Shui and the associated Emperor Star astrology in Singapore. Its services include building and office design consultancy, astrology readings, marriage matching, aura readings, and business talks and seminars for large corporations. The company also offers tarot cards readings, and an online dating service using Feng Shui principles. It serves businessmen, political figures, business enterprises, and the general public. The company was formerly known as New Trend Lifestyle Group Plc and changed its name to Conduity Capital Plc in October 2020. Conduity Capital Plc was founded in 2005 and is based in London, the United Kingdom.
